lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters concentrated in the mid-lateral region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear ridges on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs bounded within the trailing edge and center of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.
